World model (revised):
- Object moves a FIXED 5 cells per action (confirmed: two LEFTs moved it 5+5). Current: rows 45-49, cols 24-28.
- Yellow bar = step budget (now 39 left); each action costs 1.
- Top black box interior is exactly 5×5 (rows 10-14, cols 34-38) — matches object size → likely the goal dock. Pillar (cols 34-38, rows 17-24) is exactly 5 wide → the only route up.
- White plus (rows 31-33, cols 19-21) sits where the object can overlap it (rows 30-34, cols 19-23) → likely a collectible on the way.
- Plan: LEFT, UP×3 to cover the plus, then check if it's collected; then route via top row to pillar and dock into the box.
